subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should Antigravity automatic mode surface the most constrained exhausted quota whenever another model family remains usable, or should exhausted and usable lanes be selected differently by menu-bar and highest-usage contexts?
rationale: Current main and its tests intentionally skip exhausted windows when another lane is usable, while this PR deliberately reverses that user-visible contract; source correctness cannot determine which product meaning of automatic the repository wants.

options.title: Adopt binding-quota semantics
options.body: Use the PR's shared most-constrained ranking so an exhausted recognized lane wins until every family is blocked and Antigravity is excluded.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Show an actionable exhausted reset in reset-focused menu text while keeping percentage and highest-usage ranking on the most-used usable lane.

options.title: Preserve current semantics
options.body: Continue skipping exhausted Antigravity windows whenever another recognized lane remains usable and close or substantially narrow this PR.

recommendation.title: Adopt binding-quota semantics
recommendation.body: Use the PR's shared most-constrained ranking so an exhausted recognized lane wins until every family is blocked and Antigravity is excluded.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was directly asked to confirm this exact user-visible policy and is the strongest available decision owner.
